# AI-NIDS Dataset Directory

This directory stores raw and processed benchmark datasets for AI-NIDS training, validation, and benchmarking.

> **Data Integrity Notice**: Raw datasets and processed parquets are not committed to Git (they are ignored in `.gitignore`).

---

## 1. Primary Dataset: CIC-IDS2017

* **Provider**: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (University of New Brunswick)
* **Official URL**: [UNB CIC-IDS2017](https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/ids-2017.html)
* **Structure**: 8 CSV files generated by CICFlowMeter containing ~2.83 million bidirectional network flows across 5 days (Monday to Friday).
* **Expected Files in `dataset/raw/`**:
  * `Monday-WorkingHours.pcap_ISCX.csv` (Benign baseline)
  * `Tuesday-WorkingHours.pcap_ISCX.csv` (FTP-Patator, SSH-Patator)
  * `Wednesday-workingHours.pcap_ISCX.csv` (DoS: Slowloris, Slowhttptest, Hulk, GoldenEye; Heartbleed)
  * `Thursday-WorkingHours-Morning-WebAttacks.pcap_ISCX.csv` (Brute Force, XSS, SQL Injection)
  * `Thursday-WorkingHours-Afternoon-Infilteration.pcap_ISCX.csv` (Infiltration)
  * `Friday-WorkingHours-Morning.pcap_ISCX.csv` (Botnet ARES)
  * `Friday-WorkingHours-Afternoon-PortScan.pcap_ISCX.csv` (PortScan)
  * `Friday-WorkingHours-Afternoon-DDos.pcap_ISCX.csv` (DDoS LOIC)

---

## 2. Secondary Dataset (Cross-Dataset Evaluation): UNSW-NB15

* **Provider**: Cyber Range Lab of UNSW Canberra Cyber
* **Official URL**: [UNSW-NB15 Dataset](https://research.unsw.edu.au/projects/unsw-nb15-dataset)
* **Use Case**: Used in Phase 3 for cross-dataset generalization experiments (RQ2).

---

## 3. Synthetic Sample Generator

For automated testing and CI pipelines when raw multi-gigabyte datasets are not locally downloaded, a synthetic flow generator is provided in `ml_engine/sample_generator.py` to produce schema-conformant sample parquets.
